description: Gain 3 random Emblems, a Reforger, and 4 gold.

name: TONS of Stats!
description: Your team gains 88 Health, 8% Attack Damage, 8% Ability Power, 8 Armor, 8 Magic Resist, 8% Attack Speed, and 8 Mana.

name: Trait Ladder
description: Gain a random emblem. After fielding 2 non-unique traits in a player combat, gain a reward. Then increase the number of traits needed and the size of the reward.

name: Upward Mobility
description: Buying XP costs 1 less. Gain 2 Health and 2 Shop rerolls whenever you level up.

name: Urf's Grab Bag
description: Gain 1 Spatula, 3 random components, and 5 gold.

name: Verticality III
description: Champions gain 4% Attack Damage, 4% Ability Power, 3.5 Armor, and 3.5 Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

name: Wand Overflow
description: Gain 4 Needlessly Large Rods. Your Needlessly Large Rods grant +5% Attack Speed.

name: We Stick Together
description: Gain an Emblem of a random trait and a completed item anvil. Allies with that trait gain 30% Attack Speed.

name: Worth the Wait II
description: Gain 2 copies of a random 2-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game.
